goal: Add input validation to POST and PATCH /todos endpoints, returning 400 with JSON error messages for missing/blank titles and invalid payloads.
scope_summary: Add guard clauses at the top of the POST and PATCH route handlers in src/routes/todos.ts to validate request bodies before passing data to the store. POST rejects missing or blank title. PATCH rejects empty-string title and non-boolean completed values. All validation errors return 400 with { error: '...' } matching the existing error response shape. A new test file tests/validation.test.ts covers these cases using the same vitest+supertest pattern as todos.test.ts.
planned_changes: Add title validation (missing and blank) to POST / handler in src/routes/todos.ts, returning 400 with JSON error before calling store.add()
Add payload validation to PATCH /:id handler in src/routes/todos.ts: reject empty-string title and non-boolean completed, returning 400 with JSON error before calling store.update()
Create tests/validation.test.ts with two describe blocks: 'POST /todos rejects missing title' and 'PATCH /todos/:id rejects invalid payload', using vitest+supertest against createApp()
acceptance_checks: POST /todos with missing title returns 400 with JSON error
POST /todos with blank title returns 400 with JSON error
PATCH /todos/:id with empty title returns 400 with JSON error
PATCH /todos/:id with wrong data types returns 400 with JSON error
All error responses are JSON with descriptive messages
Unit test: validation.test.ts > 'POST /todos rejects missing title' verifies validation
Unit test: validation.test.ts > 'PATCH /todos/:id rejects invalid payload' verifies validation
commit_message: feat(F008): add input validation returning 400 for invalid POST/PATCH payloads
risks: PATCH allows partial updates — validation must not reject requests that omit title or completed entirely, only reject when provided values are invalid
express.json() middleware returns its own 400 for malformed JSON before the route handler runs — tests must account for this if testing raw malformed bodies
Existing tests in todos.test.ts send POST without validation expectations — ensure new validation does not break existing tests that send valid payloads
